_comment: How results/highell/namaster_spectra was actually produced. results/ is a symlink into /sptlocal and is gitignored, so this record lives in the repository instead. analysis/spectra.py reads it and decides from `pixel_window` alone whether the HEALPix window has to be multiplied back in. If the stage is rerun under the universe's own flat_only decision, update `pixel_window` here to flat_only and nothing else in the analysis changes.
source: grid/ run 2026-09-04; command line recorded in grid/logs/bandpowers_*.err, all 100 of which carry --pixel-window healpix_and_flat
command: python3 namaster_spectra.py --qu-maps qu --eb-maps eb --masks masks --workspaces workspaces --projections <proj> --seed-start <s> --seed-stop <s+1> --purify-b purify --pixel-window healpix_and_flat --lmax l6000 --delta-ell 50 --max-procs 2 --out out
discrepancy: universes/highell.yaml declares pixel_window: flat_only, and the bandpowers on disk were made with healpix_and_flat. The files, not the universe file, are what this record describes.
